Sab Se Aula o Aala Hamara Nabi 🌹

Kalam: Ala Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan (Rahmatullahi Alaih), Hadaiq-e-Bakhshish
Recited by: Hafiz Ahmed Raza Qadri
Original: Hafiz Ahmed Raza Qadri on YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=QedVXycj7Sk)
All rights belong to the reciter and the original publisher. Shared with love and full credit, for the Mehfil. Listen to the complete naat on the original channel. 🤍

Sab se aula o aala hamara Nabi, sab se bala o wala hamara Nabi. Apne Maula ka pyara hamara Nabi, dono aalam ka dulha hamara Nabi (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam).
